title: Completion under restriction of embedded integral coefficients
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite intermediate field E of PadicAlgCl ell, pi in its embedded ring of integers generating the maximal ideal, and a Noetherian scheme X in any universe u. Use the actual constant and continuous ring objects, scalar map, restriction functor and local kernel-ideal completeness predicates of [def-sfb-embedded-integral-model-coefficients]. Restriction from continuous to constant coefficients induces an equivalence from completedComplete to constantComplete, with its forward functor naturally isomorphic to the ambient restriction. For every ambient derived object K, completedComplete K if and only if constantComplete (restriction K). No boundedness or constructibility of K is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the underived embedded coefficient lemma: the constant residue kernel is finite type, the actual small scalar map is flat and induces the common residue quotient, and its extended kernel is the completed residue kernel.

Apply flat_ringed_ideal_complete_equivalence to this map and kernel. Identify the completed ideal by the kernel equality. Section-module equivalence followed by AsSmall pushforward is an exact equivalence; localize it and transport the complete full subcategories and the inclusion comparison through it. The ordinary scalar square is identity on underlying sections, so its localization identifies the resulting forward functor with the specified ambient restriction.

For any ambient derived object, compare its smallDerivedObject with the exact derived smallModules functor using its localization representative isomorphism. Apply siteDerivedRestrictScalars_locallyDerivedComplete_iff with the same kernel, and transport along the localized scalar square. Local completeness is invariant under isomorphism because it is vanishing of functorial derived internal-Hom objects. This proves the iff for every complex, without a bound.

lean.statement:
theorem integralModelsEmbeddedCompletion
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers ℓ E.1))
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] :
    (∃ e : ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X) ≌
        ObjectProperty.FullSubcategory (IntegralModelsEmbedded.constantComplete ℓ E π X),
      Nonempty (e.functor ⋙ ObjectProperty.ι (IntegralModelsEmbedded.constantComplete ℓ E π X) ≅
        ObjectProperty.ι (IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X) ⋙
          IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X)) ∧
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory.{u + 1} (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
        (integralCoefficientObject X ℓ E)),
      IntegralModelsEmbedded.completedComplete ℓ E π X K ↔
        IntegralModelsEmbedded.constantComplete ℓ E π X
          ((IntegralModelsEmbedded.restriction ℓ E X).obj K)
